implementation_constraints: reads one JSON value from stdin, prints one line, exits 0

unresolved_intent.decision: Emit preempt only if previous running job is still active (in active_jobs), not if it completed or was missed
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec step 3 requires 'if the previous running job is still ready'; we interpret ready as remaining in the active set; step 4 removes completed jobs before the next tick's preemption check

unresolved_intent.decision: When multiple jobs share highest priority, select by earliest arrival, then by lowest id as secondary and tertiary tiebreakers
unresolved_intent.rationale: Step 3 explicitly specifies this tiebreaking order; deterministic selection is essential for reproducibility; implemented as sort key tuple: (-priority, arrival, id)

unresolved_intent.decision: Jobs with duration 0 never decrement remaining (already 0), emit start and complete in same tick
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec step 4 says 'decrease by one unless already zero'; duration 0 means immediate completion; start and complete both occur in the tick of selection with no execution work

unresolved_intent.decision: Emit idle only when no jobs are active (ready) AND at least one job has future arrival (pending)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec prohibits idle 'when no job is ready and no job is pending'; idle signals waiting for future arrival; if no pending exists, simulation ends instead

unresolved_intent.decision: Break main loop when active_jobs is empty and no pending jobs exist, after completing the current tick
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec: 'end after the tick in which last job completes or is missed' and 'shall not emit idle when...no pending'; loop structure ensures step 4 executes before termination check
